test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements :

1. Jhelum River passes through Wular Lake. 

2. Krishna River directly feeds Kolleru Lake.

3. Meandering of the Gandak River formed Kanwar Lake.

How many of the statements given above are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Wular Lake:**

 
 
• One of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia, the Wular Lake is located in Jammu and Kashmir where the Jhelum river feeds it. 
 
• *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
 
 
• Kolleru Lake: 
 
 
• It is situated in northeastern Andhra Pradesh.
 
• ​It lies between the Godavari and Krishna river deltas near the city of Eluru. 
 
• The Krishna River does not directly feed Kolleru Lake. 
 
• *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect*.
 
 
 
• The Kanwar Lake:
 
 
• It is an oxbow lake formed by the meandering of the Burhi Gandak River. 
 
• Oxbow lakes are crescent-shaped lakes that are formed when a river changes course and leaves behind a loop of its former channel.
 
• The **Burhi **Gandak River is a tributary of the Ganga River and flows through Bihar.
 
• *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.*
